name: ultra11y
description: Accessibility for WCAG 2.2 AA and country standards (RGAA…): an automatic review of the code under change before every commit, push and pull request, plus full audits and conformance deliverables on demand.

interface.shortDescription: WCAG 2.2 AA review before you commit, push or open a PR.
interface.longDescription: Reviews exactly the code under change against WCAG 2.2 AA. A zero-dependency static engine — 78 checks tied to the success criteria, scored against the W3C ACT corpus — plus the agent's judgment on what a static pass cannot decide, with check/verify gates against invented non-conformities. Country standards (RGAA…) are pluggable in-repo packs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review my staged changes for accessibility.
